user-stories.text: A terminal verifies an NFT output before consuming its application root. The role diagram shows green anchors supplying roots, blue ledger providers supplying data and proofs, orange application services building proofs and purple terminals verifying before action. Providers explicitly refuse unavailable views.

choose-trust-and-buy-availability.text: Running your own anchor is the optimal deal for trust independence. Chosen institutional publications are an exceptionally attractive operational deal under explicit institutional trust. Both let applications buy capacity. Follow the trust and availability page for the assumptions.

read-the-design.text: Use concepts to understand assets and roots, and the projects page to find CSMT-UTXO, MPFS and Singular. Continue to trust choices, architecture, chainpoint sessions, evidence and the roadmap.

repository-scope.text: Lockness owns cross-project design and acceptance. Component repositories own implementation. CSMT-UTXO supplies commitment machinery; the ledger provider still needs substantial storage and query work.

check-the-documentation.text: The documentation script checks source-bound rendered diagrams, speech freshness and a strict site build. Regenerate diagrams from the manifest with the pinned renderer, then inspect every render and update narration. Source and image hashes prove freshness, not visual accuracy or protocol correctness.
